cues.text: The mall fountain. The hero and Elizabeth walk up to it.
Elizabeth flings handful after handful of coins into the fountain.
Elizabeth turns and walks off. The hero follows.
They stop at a police box, beside a board of posters.
Elizabeth steps up to the window.
Elizabeth walks off. The hero follows.
Red padded club doors behind a rope line.
Elizabeth walks up to the doors.
She turns back to the hero.
Elizabeth dances in front of the doors, flinging her arms out in wide poses.
Elizabeth walks away, leaving the hero by the doors.
She stops by a long pool.
Then she hurries back to the hero.
